code:
model_name = "gpt-4o"   # str
max_tokens = 500          # int
temperature = 0.7         # float
is_streaming = True       # bool
caption: Python infers the type from the value you assign — dynamic typing.

code:
str     "gpt-4o"      text
int     500            whole number
float   0.7            decimal
bool    True / False   exactly these two
None    None            "no value yet"
caption: None is distinct from 0, "", or False — it means nothing was set.
Python never silently mixes types — you convert explicitly.

code:
model_name = "gpt-4o"
temperature = 0.7

print(f"Calling {model_name} at {temperature}")
# Calling gpt-4o at 0.7
caption: The pattern you'll use constantly for prompts, logs, and errors.
